note: East Feliciana Parish has zoning (Municode Chapter 12 cites an official planning and zoning map, Sec. 12-84), but no zoning-district polygon layer is published as a queryable service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the parish, town and GIS-directory pages found only parcel layers (EFAOParcels, Eagleview parcels, which carry no district code) and FEMA flood layers.
